description: Chat-shaped completions only, matching Warden phase 1's scope (no tool calls). Short prompts on purpose -- the comparison cares about engine overhead (load time, TTFT, tokens/sec), not model reasoning depth.

messages.content: Hi! What can you help me with?
In two sentences, explain what a self-hosted app means.
List three benefits of keeping your data on your own server.
The capital of France is Paris.
Write a short paragraph (about 80 words) describing what a home assistant chatbot could do for someone managing their tasks and notes.
